scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's missing loyalty discount problem in own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at turn 42 for his account reference which was already provided at turn 3.

grader.scenario: Contract renewal loyalty discount missing from invoice; resolved via manual promotion attachment and refund
grader.notes: Good call where agent was courteous, empathetic, and resolved billing error completely, failing only paraphrasing and active listening repeat in the final third.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net customer accounts and billing' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Marcus throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand your frustration and disappointment at seeing a higher amount deducted...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the billing discount issue in own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for account reference at turn 42 despite customer stating SN-550182 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent manually attached discount, issued refund, sent PDF confirmation, and waived paper billing fee.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained polite, empathetic, and highly professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered necessary dates and discount amounts.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer received PDF confirmation, verified £35 tariff, and received refund SMS confirmation.
